dataset_name: CERT Insider Threat r4.2 (SentinelAI-Q Quantum ML Prepared)

pca_1.description: First principal component derived from standard-scaled daily behavioural features.

pca_2.description: Second principal component derived from standard-scaled daily behavioural features.

pca_3.description: Third principal component derived from standard-scaled daily behavioural features.

pca_4.description: Fourth principal component derived from standard-scaled daily behavioural features.

input_behavioral_features.is_weekend: Binary flag (1 if date is Saturday or Sunday, else 0)
input_behavioral_features.logon_count: Total successful logons during the day (from logon.csv)
input_behavioral_features.logoff_count: Total logoffs during the day (from logon.csv)
input_behavioral_features.logon_after_hours_count: Logons before 07:00, after 18:00, or on weekends
input_behavioral_features.logoff_after_hours_count: Logoffs before 07:00, after 18:00, or on weekends
input_behavioral_features.first_logon_hour: Decimal hour of earliest logon of the day (e.g., 8.5 for 08:30)
input_behavioral_features.last_logoff_hour: Decimal hour of latest logoff of the day (e.g., 17.5 for 17:30)
input_behavioral_features.work_duration_hours: Duration in hours between last logoff and first logon
input_behavioral_features.logon_pc_count: Number of distinct workstations logged into during the day
input_behavioral_features.usb_connect_count: Number of USB removable drive Connect events (from device.csv)
input_behavioral_features.usb_disconnect_count: Number of USB removable drive Disconnect events (from device.csv)
input_behavioral_features.usb_after_hours_count: Number of USB Connect events outside business hours or on weekends
input_behavioral_features.usb_pc_count: Number of distinct workstations with USB connections
input_behavioral_features.file_copy_count: Total files copied to removable media (from file.csv)
input_behavioral_features.file_after_hours_count: File copies to removable media outside business hours or on weekends
input_behavioral_features.file_exe_count: Executable files (.exe) copied to removable media
input_behavioral_features.file_pc_count: Number of distinct workstations where files were copied
input_behavioral_features.email_sent_count: Total emails sent during the day (from email.csv)
input_behavioral_features.email_after_hours_count: Emails sent outside business hours or on weekends
input_behavioral_features.email_total_size: Total size in bytes of sent emails
input_behavioral_features.email_mean_size: Mean size in bytes per sent email
input_behavioral_features.email_total_attachments: Total count of email attachments sent
input_behavioral_features.email_max_attachments: Maximum attachment count in any single email sent
input_behavioral_features.email_external_recipients: Count of emails sent to external recipients (non-@dtaa.com)
input_behavioral_features.email_internal_recipients: Count of emails sent to internal organizational recipients (@dtaa.com)
input_behavioral_features.email_distinct_recipients: Total unique recipient email addresses contacted during the day
input_behavioral_features.logon_failures: Documented placeholder (0). In CERT r4.2 schema, logon failures are NOT recorded; logon.csv records only successful 'Logon' and 'Logoff' events. Excluded from PCA fitting due to zero variance.

target_label.label: Binary ground-truth label (1 = Malicious user-day, 0 = Benign user-day)
target_label.scenario: Scenario ID (1: After-hours data theft/wikileaks, 2: Employment solicitation/thumb drive theft, 3: Disgruntled sysadmin keylogger installation & supervisor impersonation, 0: Benign)
